This is the first port call by a Chinese navy hospital ship in Senegal.

Les principaux termes du vocabulaire mar: The main terms of maritime and port vocabulary.
Manœuvre d'approche finale du navire à l: The vessel's final approach manoeuvre to the structure (quay or jetty) designed to allow vessels to berth, moor and be worked (loading/unloading).
Se distingue du contrat de transport (re: Distinct from a contract of carriage (delivery of cargo). Chartering concerns the use and enjoyment of the vessel by the charterer (the “owner” makes the vessel available to the charterer); a contract of carriage concerns the cargo which the shipper entrusts to the carrier in exchange for payment of freight.
Personne qui loue un navire ou qui explo: A person who hires a vessel or operates a chartered vessel, under the terms of the charter agreement or charter party.
Immobilisation d'un navire au moyen d'au: Securing a vessel by means of mooring lines (ropes) to a quay or a buoy.
Personne qui arme un navire en lui fourn: A person who fits out a vessel, providing equipment, provisions, fuel, crew and everything necessary for navigation. They operate the vessel in their own name, whether or not they own it.
Opération qui consiste à fixer solidemen: The operation of securely fastening cargo aboard the vessel.
Fourniture des marchandises, vivres et c: Supply of the goods, provisions and fuel needed on board the vessel for the sea voyage.

Pour le Président de la République, nos: For the President of the Republic, our port infrastructure must no longer be simple transit zones, but genuine levers for creating national wealth. Harnessing our maritime resources and gaining full control of our logistics chain form the foundation of this restored sovereignty.
La modernisation du secteur ne se limite: Modernising the sector is not limited to the capital. The presidential vision calls for harmonious integration between the Port of Dakar and the regional ports (Kaolack, Ziguinchor, Saint-Louis). Flagship projects such as Pier 4 (Jambaar Project) to quadruple our throughput and the development of the Ndayane deep-water port embody this drive to position Senegal at the forefront of global trade.
Le Port de Dakar de demain se veut intel: Tomorrow's Port of Dakar aims to be smart, high-performing and sustainable. Accelerating the digitalisation of administrative procedures, reducing cargo transit times and strict compliance with environmental standards are at the heart of our commitments to guarantee our platform's international competitiveness.
